tool_args.rationale: The pilot suggests a saturating response, but the bridge and flux-conservation signatures leave competing mechanisms indistinguishable under the one-dimensional pilot design. A discriminating probe is warranted before fitting.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations vary only u_now, so they cannot identify dependence on the other inputs or distinguish the bridge mechanism.
The cheaper open-branch probe is designed to resolve the current structural ambiguity.
It is not relevant to identifying the transfer mechanism.
